The morning sun shone through the kitchen window. A small bird landed on the fence and sang while the trees moved gently in the breeze. After breakfast, we walked down the quiet path beside the river. The water was clear, and we could see smooth stones beneath the surface. We stopped under a large tree to rest and share some bread. In the distance, children were playing on the grass near their home. When the clouds began to gather, we turned back along the path. We reached the house before the rain and sat together with warm cups of tea.
